about: Bridgewater is a town on the LaHave River in Lunenburg County, Nova Scotia, inland from the South Shore fishing ports. A regional commercial centre—often called the main street of the South Shore—it has a riverfront downtown, mills heritage, and services for surrounding rural communities. About 9,000 people live in Bridgewater.
